selection: non-merge commits in the task window changing 1-5 files, all under packages/; not dependency, release, docs-only or test-only; ranked by sha256(seed:sha); first 40
query: commit subject without its trailing PR number
hit: a top-5 history record is a commit that touched at least one gold file

baselines.recent: the 5 most recent non-merge commits before the cut
baselines.words: the 5 most recent non-merge commits before the cut, in the import window, whose subject shares a word (3+ letters, not a stopword) with the query

rules: No tuning against these tasks. A fix needs a new frozen set. Misses are reported as absent from the index or ranked below fifth.
